title: Three Seasons and One Short Brush
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：saying　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 saying 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the painter ① quoted the saying that no visitor in the studio would have described, and he said the quoting was the whole of the season. The ② saying, meaning the proverb itself and not the brush, ran three seasons and stayed undescribed in the book; a saying, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ saying in that studio had the same short brush beside it, and the ④ saying at the far easel, meaning the sketch they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A saying, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the painter said the describing is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the saying was the whole of the matter, meaning the wisdom and not the proverb. The ⑥ saying, meaning the wisdom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; saying, he said, is either something you quote or the only word that means both a proverb and a wisdom. He said the wisdom is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ saying had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the short brush. The ⑧ saying of the whole thing, the painter wrote in May, was one studio and three seasons of describing; saying, he said, is either the sketch at the far easel or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ saying I remember is the proverb described in the catalogue, which closed in 1982 and is still described as the quietest in the studio. A ⑩ saying, my mother said in 1984, is the only proverb that improves by being described; every saying, she said, is a wisdom that has agreed to look like a proverb. She said the wisdom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 谚语；说法（指画室里每一句旁边的那一句）
B. n. 谚语；说法（指那句谚语本身，与小小的画笔相对）
C. 固定搭配：quote the saying 引这一句谚语
D. n. 谚语；说法（指留给孩子们留着的那一幅）
E. n. 谚语之事（抽象总称，指一处画室的谚语之事）
F. n. 谚语；说法（指展品目录里写到、被描述的那一句）
G. n. 谚语、道理（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 道理（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: quoted the saying that no visitor in the studio would have described
The saying, meaning the proverb itself and not the brush
the saying at the far easel
the saying was the whole of the matter
the saying had become a line in a catalogue
The saying of the whole thing
A saying, my mother said in 1984

answers.why: quote the saying 意为“引这一句谚语”，1975 年那位画师把画室里没有一位观者肯描述的一句谚语做了一遍。
saying 意为“谚语；说法”，指那句谚语本身而不是小小的画笔，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被描述。
saying 意为“谚语；说法”，指画室里每一句旁边的那一句，每一句旁边都有同一支小小的画笔。
saying 意为“谚语；说法”，指最远那副画架的留给孩子们留着的那一幅，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
saying 意为“谚语、道理”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这句道理就是那件事的全部。
saying 意为“道理”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那句谚语，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
saying 意为“谚语；说法”，指展品目录里写到、被描述的那一句，到 1980 年这一句成了展品目录里的一行。
saying 意为“谚语之事”，画师五月写道，整件事的谚语之事是一处画室和三个季度的描述。
saying 意为“谚语；说法”，我记得的是展品目录里描述过的那一句，1982 年画成了，至今仍被说成画室里最安静的一句。
saying 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，谚语是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的谚语。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年那位画师引了画室里没有一位观者肯描述的一句谚语，他说这一遍才是那个季度的全部。（quote the saying）
那句谚语，指的是那句谚语本身而不是小小的画笔，经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被描述。（saying）
那处画室里每一句谚语旁边都有同一支小小的画笔。（saying）
最远那副画架那句谚语，指的是他们留给孩子们留着的那一幅，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（saying）
叔叔说这句道理就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那句谚语。（saying）
1984 年母亲说，谚语是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的谚语。（saying）
